ITEM 1 | Long, flat strip of cooked meat with glossy reddish-brown to amber surface, crisp browned edges and darker caramelized spots, layered with fat striations, curled slightly; about 14 cm long by 2.5 cm wide at widest, roughly 0.5 cm thick, lying diagonally across the left-center of the plate | 35
ITEM 2 | Mixed loose salad greens with dark purple-green and bright green leaves, some ruffled, some flat and glossy, with thin pale stems; spread in a mound about 9 cm across on the center-left of the plate, moist-looking with slight sheen | 30
ITEM 3 | Halved and whole strawberries, bright red with pale seeded surfaces, soft and glossy, two or three pieces about 2 to 3 cm each, nestled among the greens on the right-center | 25
ITEM 4 | Blackberries, small dark purple-black drupelet clusters with a slightly matte surface, several small berries about 1.5 cm each scattered among the greens, plus one larger berry about 2.5 cm sitting separately on the right side of the plate | 15
ITEM 5 | Small scattered pink-red specks and flecks, possibly a light dressing residue, barely visible on the white plate near the greens and bacon | 1
